note: Large Inyo NF campground on an open sagebrush bench above the north shore of June Lake, off Hwy 158 on the June Lake Loop, at 7,600 ft. Little shade; most sites look out over the lake to the peaks. The swim beach and day-use area sit below the campground; showers and groceries are at the nearby resort. Bear lockers at every site. --Claude
